Landing.title: Find your next chavrusa
Landing.subtitle: A simple, welcoming way to connect with fellow learners for Torah study — remote or in person.
Landing.step1Body: Share what you'd like to learn, your languages, and your availability.
Landing.step2Body: Find learners who match your interests and send a connect request.
Landing.step3Body: Once matched, agree on a time and start learning together.
Landing.freeNotice: Chavrusa Link is free to join. Optional donations help keep it running.
